name: Office Time Counter
tagline: Automated attendance tracking, geofencing, and work-life balance wellness utility.
description:
Master your work-life balance with intelligent, automated attendance tracking. Seamlessly log your 'In' and 'Out' times using advanced Geofencing and notification hooks.

Built with Kotlin, Android Geofencing API, Notification Listener Service, Room DB, WorkManager, and Jetpack Compose UI.

Core Capabilities:
- Smart Geofencing Engine: High-accuracy background office entry and exit detection (GeofenceBroadcastReceiver) with configurable coordinate radii.
- Secondary Notification Hooks: Intercepts attendance notifications (NotificationService) from corporate check-in apps as an automated fail-safe.
- Real-Time Delta & Target Analytics: Calculates exact office hours, daily over/under time deltas, and remaining weekly hours automatically.
- Wellness & Break Reminders: Built-in WellnessWorker tracks movement breaks, desk fatigue, and work-life balance statistics.
- Manual Adjustments & Leave Logs: Easily record half-day, full-day, and manual adjustment entries (LeaveEntity, ManualAdjustmentEntity).
- Data Export & Cloud Backup: Export monthly attendance history to CSV/Excel files (ExportUtils) with optional Firestore backup sync.
